wireguard.help: Encrypted tunnels for remote access or site-to-site links. Changes are staged and applied with rollback.
wireguard.allowed_ips_help: Addresses this peer may use inside the tunnel, e.g. 10.9.0.2/32.
wireguard.peer_public_key_help: Paste the peer's public key, or generate a key pair here to export a ready configuration.
wireguard.key_invalid: Not a WireGuard key (44 characters of base64).
wireguard.endpoint_help: Only for peers the router connects to; leave empty for road-warrior clients.
wireguard.name: Interface name
wireguard.tunnel_address_help: The router's address in the tunnel network, e.g. 10.9.0.1/24.
wireguard.zone_help: Peers get the access of this zone, e.g. lan for full access.
wireguard.allow_wan_help: Adds a firewall rule accepting UDP on the listen port.
wireguard.export_endpoint_help: Public IP address or host name the peer connects to.
wireguard.export_full: Send all traffic through the tunnel
wireguard.export_full_help: Otherwise only the tunnel network is routed.
wireguard.qr_label: QR code of the peer configuration
wireguard.export_unavailable: Available once the tunnel runs and the peer's key pair was generated here.
wireguard.no_handler: The router does not know the WireGuard protocol yet. It was installed while the network service was running: restart the network service (or the router) once.
